description: Certificates (protocol.md §4.2, §4.3). `sign`: certificate = body || Ed25519(CA seed, context || body); body is the certificate TLV list of the fields, in registry order; fingerprint = BLAKE2s-256(certificate); text is base64. `verify`: the identity function with a PKI, in the context given (trusted CA keys, overlay prefixes as 16-byte address and prefix length, static keys, deny list); `now` is wall-clock Unix seconds; `result` is `ok` or the reject reason of §18.7; `peer` is the record returned on `ok`. `ca_keys`: the CA public keys a configuration accepts. `revoked_entries`: the deny-list entries a configuration accepts. Seeds are BLAKE2s-256('kekkai certificate vectors ' || label); node keys are those of keygen.json.
